title: Model Selection for Off-Policy Evaluation via Pairwise Bellman Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model selection and hyperparameter tuning pose a central challenge in off-policy evaluation (OPE) because errors of fitted Q-functions and occupancy-ratio estimates cannot be directly evaluated from held-out transitions. Bellman-residual and minimax validation methods often require auxiliary regressions or optimization over separate critic classes, adding computational and tuning costs. We introduce pairwise Bellman validation (PBV), a tuning-free minimax procedure for selecting among finite classes of fitted Q-functions and occupancy-ratio estimators using held-out transitions. PBV constructs critics from pairwise candidate differences, requiring only finitely many empirical moment calculations without auxiliary validation models or separate critic optimization. translated_title: 基于成对贝尔曼验证的离线策略评估模型选择方法
translated_abstract: 模型选择和超参数调整是离线策略评估（OPE）中的一个核心挑战，因为拟合的Q函数和占据率比估计的误差无法从留出的转移数据中直接评估。贝尔曼残差和极小极大验证方法通常需要辅助回归或在单独的评判函数类上进行优化，这增加了计算和调整成本。我们提出了成对贝尔曼验证（PBV），这是一种无需调参的极小极大程序，可利用留出的转移数据在有限的拟合Q函数类和占据率比估计器类中进行选择。PBV通过成对候选差异构建评判函数，只需要有限次经验矩计算，无需辅助验证模型或单独的评判函数优化。我们建立了相对于最佳可用候选者的有限样本Oracle不等式，即使在候选类存在误设的情况下也依然成立。我们的关键洞察是Q函数误差……
tldr: 该论文提出成对贝尔曼验证（PBV）方法，通过成对候选差异构建评判函数，实现离线策略评估中无需调参的模型选择，并在候选类误设情况下仍能获得有限样本Oracle保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes pairwise Bellman validation (PBV), a tuning-free minimax procedure that constructs critics from pairwise candidate differences, enabling model selection for off-policy evaluation with finite-sample oracle guarantees even under candidate-class misspecification.
